name: mark a point as surface if some cone from it contains no other point
mechanism: for each point, test a set of cone directions of fixed opening angle; if any cone anchored at the point holds none of its neighbours, the point is on the surface; otherwise it is interior

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Cone algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: identify surface points

requires: a cone opening angle and neighbour radius (policy)
fails_when: concave pockets fool the test; parameter-dependent
